run_label_demo_status_read: run the script in read mode to view point-clouds and demo_status labels for H5 episodes
run_label_demo_status_write: run the script in write mode to override demo_status labels for mislabeled H5 episodes
run_main_with_data_dir: run main with a custom data_dir path to label episodes in a specific H5 dataset directory
run_main_with_template: run main with a glob template to filter which H5 files to process for labeling
review_main_function: review the main function that iterates H5 episodes showing point-clouds and allowing demo_status overrides
